description: The same weakness on the second language, where Jinja2 takes the opposite default: autoescaping is ON, so `{{ x }}` is safe and only an explicit `| safe` opts out. The filter is therefore the whole judgement and there is no one-character difference to miss. The negatives cover the three ways this stays quiet: a value the caller never sent, a context spread from a dictionary built elsewhere -- a stated miss, because naming a file on a guess is worse than saying nothing -- and a value escaped before it reached the view, which is what `escape()` returning Markup is FOR.

expected.note: the autoescaped interpolation one line below is the same value and is silent
read as `user.name`, so the path below the root is a property read off what the handler passed
